summary: No qualifying Dallas Industrial refinance opportunities were identified with confirmed, unextended maturities between 2026-09-01 and 2027-08-31. Most Dallas assets were moved to Seattle via executed amendments effective 2026-08-20 (e.g., R2663/R5151, R7702, R3402, R7201, R7833, R1118, R8900), while others failed due to unconfirmed or inferred maturities (R2813, R4743), non-qualifying loan status (R7436, R9426), non-record ownership (R4927), non-qualifying contact role/status (R7919, R9169), stale owner verification (R1203), asset type mismatch (R5181), or maturity outside the window (R1776). A later record (R5442) was published after the 2026-08-31 cutoff and was not considered.
limitations: All assessments are limited to the provided sources and updates effective on or before 2026-08-31; later evidence (e.g., recorded releases after cutoff) was not applied.
Outstanding loan balances are not provided in the sources; nulls were preserved where not published.
Several records rely on amendments that change market; if entity-level cross-record updates were incomplete in the packet, scope determinations could be affected.
No eligible results means no ranked shortlist could be produced for the specified window and scope.
